visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top photo or video banner with a heading panel, optional text and CTA, and optional aside card (contact box, offer card, overlap card)

contentPattern.structure: Row 1 (media): background picture, and/or a link to an .mp4/.webm video (picture becomes the poster). Row 2 (content): heading, optional text and CTA links (a link alone in a paragraph becomes a button). Optional further rows: aside cards (contact box, offer card with image, overlap card). A picture alone in the first cell of the content row is also treated as the background

reuseGuidance: Use for the main banner at the top of a page. Use split for panel-beside-photo layouts, split-strip for a headline strip across the photo bottom, video/video-2 for background video. For promotional rows mid-page use columns-media or columns-promo.
